sanskrit: viśvakarmā mahābhāgo jajñe śilpaprajāpatiḥ kartā śilpasahasrāṇāṃ tridaśānāṃ ca vardhakiḥ
english: The greatly blessed Viśvakarmā was born — the Prajāpati of crafts, the maker of thousands of works of art, the carpenter of the thirty gods.

sanskrit: bhūṣaṇānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ kartā śilpavatāṃ varaḥ yo divyāni vimānāni devatānāṃ cakāra ha
english: He is the maker of all ornaments, the foremost among artisans, who fashioned the celestial aerial chariots of the gods.

sanskrit: manuṣyāś copajīvanti yasya śilpaṃ mahātmanaḥ pūjayanti ca yaṃ nityaṃ viśvakarmāṇam avyayam
english: Men live by the craft of that great-souled one, and they worship the imperishable Viśvakarmā without ceasing.

sanskrit: stanaṃ tu dakṣiṇaṃ bhittvā brahmaṇo naravigrahaḥ niḥsṛto bhagavān dharmaḥ sarvalokasukhāvahaḥ
english: Bursting through the right breast of Brahmā in human form, the blessed Dharma issued forth — he who brings happiness to all the worlds.

sanskrit: trayas tasya varāḥ putrāḥ sarvabhūtamanoharāḥ śamaḥ kāmaś ca harṣaś ca tejasā lokadhāriṇaḥ
english: He has three excellent sons, delightful to all beings — Śama (Tranquility), Kāma (Desire), and Harṣa (Joy) — who by their radiance sustain the worlds.

sanskrit: kāmasya tu ratir bhāryā śamasya prāptir aṅganā nandī tu bhāryā harṣasya yatra lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ
english: Rati (Delight) is the wife of Kāma; Prāpti (Attainment) is the consort of Śama; and Nandī (Bliss) is the wife of Harṣa — in whom the worlds are established.

sanskrit: marīceḥ kaśyapaḥ putraḥ kaśyapasya surāsurāḥ jajñire nṛpaśārdūla lokānāṃ prabhavas tu saḥ
english: Kaśyapa is the son of Marīci; from Kaśyapa were born the gods and the asuras, O tiger among kings — he is indeed the progenitor of the worlds.

sanskrit: tvāṣṭrī tu savitur bhāryā vaḍavārūpadhāriṇī asūyata mahābhāgā sāntarikṣe 'śvināv ubhau
english: Tvāṣṭrī, the greatly blessed wife of Savitṛ, assuming the form of a mare, gave birth in the sky to both the Aśvins.

sanskrit: dvādaśaivāditeḥ putrāḥ śakramukhyā narādhipa teṣām avarajo viṣṇur yatra lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ
english: Aditi has exactly twelve sons, headed by Indra, O lord of men; the youngest of them is Viṣṇu, in whom the worlds are established.

sanskrit: trayas triṃśata ity ete devās teṣām ahaṃ tava anvayaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi pakṣaiś ca kulato gaṇān
english: These are the thirty-three gods. I shall now declare to you their lineages, their factions, their clans, and their groups.

sanskrit: rudrāṇām aparaḥ pakṣaḥ sādhyānāṃ marutāṃ tathā vasūnāṃ bhārgavaṃ vidyād viśvedevāṃs tathaiva ca
english: Know the Bhārgavas as belonging to the other faction of the Rudras, the Sādhyas, the Maruts, the Vasus, and the Viśvedevas as well.

sanskrit: vainateyas tu garuḍo balavān aruṇas tathā bṛhaspatiś ca bhagavān ādityeṣv eva gaṇyate
english: The mighty Garuḍa, son of Vinatā, and likewise Aruṇa, and the blessed Bṛhaspati — these are reckoned among the Ādityas.

sanskrit: aśvibhyāṃ guhyakān viddhi sarvauṣadhyas tathā paśūn eṣa devagaṇo rājan kīrtitas te 'nupūrvaśaḥ yaṃ kīrtayitvā manujaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
english: Know the Guhyakas, all medicinal herbs, and animals as belonging to the Aśvins. O king, this host of gods has been proclaimed to you in order; a person who recites this list is freed from all sins.

sanskrit: brahmaṇo hṛdayaṃ bhittvā niḥsṛto bhagavān bhṛguḥ bhṛgoḥ putraḥ kavir vidvāñ śukraḥ kavisuto grahaḥ
english: The blessed Bhṛgu issued forth by splitting open the heart of Brahmā. The son of Bhṛgu is Kavi, the wise one; Śukra is the son of Kavi, and he became a planet (graha).

sanskrit: trailokyaprāṇayātrārthe varṣāvarṣe bhayābhaye svayaṃbhuvā niyuktaḥ san bhuvanaṃ paridhāvati
english: Appointed by the Self-born (Brahmā) for the regulation of the life-journey of the three worlds, governing rain and drought, fear and safety, he courses through the universe.

sanskrit: yogācāryo mahābuddhir daityānām abhavad guruḥ surāṇāṃ cāpi medhāvī brahmacārī yatavrataḥ
english: He became the teacher of Yoga, of great intellect, the preceptor of the Daityas and also of the gods — supremely wise, observing celibacy and firm in his vows.

sanskrit: tasmin niyukte vibhunā yogakṣemāya bhārgave anyam utpādayām āsa putraṃ bhṛgur aninditam
english: When that Bhārgava was appointed by the Lord for the welfare of the worlds, Bhṛgu sired another blameless son.

sanskrit: cyavanaṃ dīptatapasaṃ dharmātmānaṃ manīṣiṇam yaḥ sa roṣāc cyuto garbhān mātur mokṣāya bhārata
english: That son was Cyavana, blazing with ascetic power, righteous in soul and wise — he who fell from the womb in anger for the liberation of his mother, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: āruṣī tu manoḥ kanyā tasya patnī manīṣiṇaḥ aurvas tasyāṃ samabhavad ūruṃ bhittvā mahāyaśāḥ mahātapā mahātejā bāla eva guṇair yutaḥ
english: Āruṣī, the daughter of Manu, became the wife of that wise one (Cyavana). From her was born the greatly renowned Aurva, ripping through the thigh — endowed with mighty austerity, great radiance, and all virtues even as a child.

sanskrit: ṛcīkas tasya putras tu jamadagnis tato 'bhavat jamadagnes tu catvāra āsan putrāḥ mahātmanaḥ
english: Ṛcīka was the son of Aurva; from him was born Jamadagni. The great-souled Jamadagni had four sons.

sanskrit: rāmas teṣāṃ jaghanyo 'bhūd ajaghanyair guṇair yutaḥ sarvaśastrāstrakuśalaḥ kṣatriyāntakaro vaśī
english: Rāma was the youngest of them, yet endowed with qualities not of the least — skilled in all weapons and missiles, the destroyer of the Kṣatriyas, and master of himself.

sanskrit: aurvasyāsīt putraśataṃ jamadagnipurogamam teṣāṃ putrasahasrāṇi babhūvur bhṛguvistaraḥ
english: Aurva had a hundred sons, headed by Jamadagni; from them arose thousands of descendants — this is the expansion of the Bhṛgu lineage.

sanskrit: dvau putrau brahmaṇas tv anyau yayos tiṣṭhati lakṣaṇam loke dhātā vidhātā ca yau sthitau manunā saha
english: Brahmā has two other sons by whose marks the world is governed — Dhātā and Vidhātā, who dwell together with Manu.

sanskrit: tayor eva svasā devī lakṣmīḥ padmagṛhā śubhā tasyās tu mānasāḥ putrās turagā vyomacāriṇaḥ
english: The auspicious goddess Lakṣmī, dwelling in the lotus, is the sister of those two. Her mind-born sons are the horses that move through the sky.

sanskrit: varuṇasya bhāryā jyeṣṭhā tu śukrād devī vyajāyata tasyāḥ putraṃ balaṃ viddhi surāṃ ca suranandinīm
english: The eldest wife of Varuṇa, a goddess, was born from Śukra (Śukrā). Know her son to be Bala (Strength), and also Surā (Wine), the delight of the gods.

sanskrit: prajānām annakāmānām anyonyaparibhakṣaṇāt adharmas tatra saṃjātaḥ sarvabhūtavināśanaḥ
english: Among the creatures who hungered for food and who fell to devouring one another, Adharma (Unrighteousness) arose there — the destroyer of all beings.

sanskrit: tasyāpi nirṛtir bhāryā nairṛtā yena rākṣasāḥ ghorās tasyās trayaḥ putrāḥ pāpakarmaratāḥ sadā bhayo mahābhayaś caiva mṛtyur bhūtāntakas tathā
english: His wife is Nirṛti; from her the Nairṛta Rākṣasas arise. She has three sons, ever given to wicked deeds: Bhaya (Fear), Mahābhaya (Great Fear), and Mṛtyu (Death), the ender of beings.

sanskrit: kākīṃ śyenīṃ ca bhāsīṃ ca dhṛtarāṣṭrīṃ tathā śukīm tāmrā tu suṣuve devī pañcaitā lokaviśrutāḥ
english: The goddess Tāmrā gave birth to five daughters, renowned throughout the world: Kākī, Śyenī, Bhāsī, Dhṛtarāṣṭrī, and Śukī.

sanskrit: ulūkān suṣuve kākī śyenī śyenān vyajāyata bhāsī bhāsān ajanayad gṛdhrāṃś caiva janādhipa
english: Kākī gave birth to owls; Śyenī bore hawks; Bhāsī brought forth vultures and kites, O lord of the people.

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭrī tu haṃsāṃś ca kalahaṃsāṃś ca sarvaśaḥ cakravākāṃś ca bhadraṃ te prajajñe sā tu bhāminī
english: Dhṛtarāṣṭrī — that spirited one — gave birth to swans, royal swans, and chakravāka birds in full, blessings to you.

sanskrit: śukī vijajñe dharmajña śukān eva manasvinī kalyāṇaguṇasaṃpannā sarvalakṣaṇapūjitā
english: O knower of righteousness, Śukī — high-minded, endowed with auspicious qualities, honored by all marks of excellence — gave birth only to parrots.

sanskrit: nava krodhavaśā nārīḥ prajajñe 'py ātmasaṃbhavāḥ mṛgīṃ ca mṛgamandāṃ ca hariṃ bhadramanām api
english: Krodhavaśa also gave birth to nine daughters of her own: Mṛgī, Mṛgamandā, Hari, and Bhadramanā —

sanskrit: mātaṅgīm atha śārdūlīṃ śvetāṃ surabhim eva ca sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannāṃ surasāṃ ca yaśasvinīm
english: — and Mātaṅgī, Śārdūlī, Śvetā, Surabhī endowed with all auspicious marks, and the illustrious Surasā.

sanskrit: apatyaṃ tu mṛgāḥ sarve mṛgyā naravarātmaja ṛkṣāś ca mṛgamandāyāḥ sṛmarāś camarā api
english: All deer are the offspring of Mṛgī, O son of the best of men. From Mṛgamandā came bears, sṛmaras (a deer species), and yaks.

sanskrit: tatas tv airāvataṃ nāgaṃ jajñe bhadramanā sutam airāvataḥ sutas tasyā devanāgo mahāgajaḥ
english: From Bhadramanā was born the great serpent Airāvata as her son; Airāvata's son is the divine elephant Mahāgaja.

sanskrit: haryāś ca harayo 'patyaṃ vānarāś ca tarasvinaḥ golāṅgūlāṃś ca bhadraṃ te haryāḥ putrān pracakṣate
english: The offspring of Hari are the lions and the swift monkeys; the golāṅgūlas too — blessings to you — are called the children of Hari.

sanskrit: prajajñe tv atha śārdūlī siṃhān vyāghrāṃś ca bhārata dvīpinaś ca mahābhāga sarvān eva na saṃśayaḥ
english: And Śārdūlī gave birth to lions, tigers, and leopards, O Bhārata — all of them, O greatly fortunate one, without doubt.

sanskrit: mātaṅgyās tv atha mātaṅgā apatyāni narādhipa diśāgajaṃ tu śvetākhyaṃ śvetājanayad āśugam
english: The offspring of Mātaṅgī are the mātaṅgas (elephants), O lord of men. And Śvetā gave birth to the swift directional elephant called Śveta.

sanskrit: tathā duhitarau rājan surabhir vai vyajāyata rohiṇīṃ caiva bhadraṃ te gandharvīṃ ca yaśasvinīm rohiṇyāṃ jajñire gāvo gandharvyāṃ vājinaḥ sutāḥ
english: Likewise, O king, Surabhī gave birth to two daughters — blessings to you — Rohiṇī and the illustrious Gandharvī. From Rohiṇī were born cattle, and from Gandharvī her sons were horses.

sanskrit: surasājanayan nāgān rājan kadrūś ca pannagān sapta piṇḍaphalān vṛkṣān analāpi vyajāyata analāyāḥ śukī putrī kadrvās tu surasā sutā
english: Surasā gave birth to nāgas, O king, and Kadrū brought forth serpents. Analā also gave birth to seven trees bearing round fruits. Śukī is the daughter of Analā, and Surasā is the daughter of Kadrū.

sanskrit: aruṇasya bhāryā śyenī tu vīryavantau mahābalau saṃpātiṃ janayām āsa tathaiva ca jaṭāyuṣam dvau putrau vinatāyās tu vikhyātau garuḍāruṇau
english: Śyenī, the wife of Aruṇa, gave birth to Saṃpāti and likewise Jaṭāyu — two mighty, powerful sons. And Vinatā's two famous sons are Garuḍa and Aruṇa.

sanskrit: ity eṣa sarvabhūtānāṃ mahatāṃ manujādhipa prabhavaḥ kīrtitaḥ samyaṅ mayā matimatāṃ vara
english: Thus has the origin of all these great beings been fully proclaimed by me, O lord of men, O best of the wise.

sanskrit: yaṃ śrutvā puruṣaḥ samyak pūto bhavati pāpmanaḥ sarvajñatāṃ ca labhate gatim agryāṃ ca vindati
english: Having properly heard this, a person is purified of sin, attains omniscience, and finds the highest path.

sanskrit: janamejaya uvāca devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca yakṣāṇām atha rakṣasām anyeṣāṃ caiva bhūtānāṃ sarveṣāṃ bhagavann aham
english: Janamejaya said: O blessed one, I wish to hear truly about the births and deeds of all these great-souled beings — gods, dānavas, yakṣas, rākṣasas, and all other beings —

sanskrit: śrotum icchāmi tattvena mānuṣeṣu mahātmanām janma karma ca bhūtānām eteṣām anupūrvaśaḥ
english: — how they were born among men, and their deeds, in proper order.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca mānuṣeṣu manuṣyendra saṃbhūtā ye divaukasaḥ prathamaṃ dānavāṃś caiva tāṃs te vakṣyāmi sarvaśaḥ
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: O lord of men, I shall tell you in full about those heavenly beings and also the dānavas who were born among humans — them first.

sanskrit: vipracittir iti khyāto ya āsīd dānavarṣabhaḥ jarāsaṃdha iti khyātaḥ sa āsīn manujarṣabhaḥ
english: He who was known as Vipracitti, the bull among dānavas — he was born among men as the famous Jarāsaṃdha, the bull among men.

sanskrit: diteḥ putras tu yo rājan hiraṇyakaśipuḥ smṛtaḥ sa jajñe mānuṣe loke śiśupālo nararṣabhaḥ
english: He who, O king, is remembered as Hiraṇyakaśipu, son of Diti — he was born in the human world as Śiśupāla, the bull among men.

sanskrit: saṃhrāda iti vikhyātaḥ prahrādasyānujas tu yaḥ sa śalya iti vikhyāto jajñe bāhlīkapuṃgavaḥ
english: He who was famed as Saṃhrāda, the younger brother of Prahrāda — he was born as the renowned Śalya, the bull of the Bāhlīkas.

sanskrit: anuhrādas tu tejasvī yo 'bhūt khyāto jaghanyajaḥ dhṛṣṭaketur iti khyātaḥ sa āsīn manujeśvaraḥ
english: The radiant Anuhrāda, who was known as the lastborn, became famed as Dhṛṣṭaketu, a lord among men.

sanskrit: yas tu rājañ śibir nāma daiteyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ druma ity abhivikhyātaḥ sa āsīd bhuvi pārthivaḥ
english: He who, O king, was celebrated as the Daitya named Śibi — he was widely known as Druma and was a king on earth.

sanskrit: bāṣkalo nāma yas teṣām āsīd asurasattamaḥ bhagadatta iti khyātaḥ sa āsīn manujeśvaraḥ
english: He among them who was the excellent asura named Bāṣkala — he was known as Bhagadatta and was a lord among men.

sanskrit: ayaḥśirā aśvaśirā ayaḥśaṅkuś ca vīryavān tathā gaganamūrdhā ca vegavāṃś cātra pañcamaḥ
english: Ayaḥśirā, Aśvaśirā, the valiant Ayaḥśaṅku, Gaganamūrdhā, and Vegavān as the fifth —

sanskrit: pañcaite jajñire rājan vīryavanto mahāsurāḥ kekayeṣu mahātmānaḥ pārthivarṣabhasattamāḥ
english: — these five valiant great asuras were born, O king, as great-souled ones among the Kekayas, the very best of royal bulls.

sanskrit: ketumān iti vikhyāto yas tato 'nyaḥ pratāpavān amitaujā iti khyātaḥ pṛthivyāṃ so 'bhavann nṛpaḥ
english: He who was otherwise known as the glorious Ketumān — he became known on earth as Amitaujā, a king.

sanskrit: svarbhānur iti vikhyātaḥ śrīmān yas tu mahāsuraḥ ugrasena iti khyāta ugrakarmā narādhipaḥ
english: He who was the glorious great asura known as Svarbhānu — he became known as Ugrasena, the fierce-actioned lord of men.

sanskrit: yas tv aśva iti vikhyātaḥ śrīmān āsīn mahāsuraḥ aśoko nāma rājāsīn mahāvīryaparākramaḥ
english: He who was the glorious great asura known as Aśva — he became the king named Aśoka, of mighty valor and prowess.

sanskrit: tasmād avarajo yas tu rājann aśvapatiḥ smṛtaḥ daiteyaḥ so 'bhavad rājā hārdikyo manujarṣabhaḥ
english: He who was the younger brother of that one, O king, remembered as the Daitya Aśvapati — he became the king Hārdikya, the bull among men.

sanskrit: vṛṣaparveti vikhyātaḥ śrīmān yas tu mahāsuraḥ dīrghaprajña iti khyātaḥ pṛthivyāṃ so 'bhavan nṛpaḥ
english: He who was the glorious great asura known as Vṛṣaparvan — he became known on earth as Dīrghaprajña, a king.

sanskrit: ajakas tv anujo rājan ya āsīd vṛṣaparvaṇaḥ sa malla iti vikhyātaḥ pṛthivyām abhavan nṛpaḥ
english: He who was the younger brother of Vṛṣaparvan, O king — Ajaka — became known on earth as Malla, a king.

sanskrit: aśvagrīva iti khyātaḥ sattvavān yo mahāsuraḥ rocamāna iti khyātaḥ pṛthivyāṃ so 'bhavan nṛpaḥ
english: He who was the powerful great asura known as Aśvagrīva — he became known on earth as Rocamāna, a king.

sanskrit: sūkṣmas tu matimān rājan kīrtimān yaḥ prakīrtitaḥ bṛhanta iti vikhyātaḥ kṣitāv āsīt sa pārthivaḥ
english: He who was celebrated, O king, as Sūkṣma, the wise and the famous — he became known on earth as Bṛhanta, a king.

sanskrit: tuhuṇḍa iti vikhyāto ya āsīd asurottamaḥ senābindur iti khyātaḥ sa babhūva narādhipaḥ
english: He who was known as Tuhuṇḍa, the foremost among asuras — he became known as Senābindu, a lord of men.

sanskrit: isṛpā nāma yas teṣām asurāṇāṃ balādhikaḥ pāpajin nāma rājāsīd bhuvi vikhyātavikramaḥ
english: He among those asuras named Isṛpā, who was supreme in strength — he became the king named Pāpajit on earth, renowned for his valor.

sanskrit: ekacakra iti khyāta āsīd yas tu mahāsuraḥ prativindhya iti khyāto babhūva prathitaḥ kṣitau
english: He who was known as the great asura Ekacakra — he became renowned on earth as Prativindhya.

sanskrit: virūpākṣas tu daiteyaś citrayodhī mahāsuraḥ citravarmeti vikhyātaḥ kṣitāv āsīt sa pārthivaḥ
english: The Daitya Virūpākṣa, a great asura of variegated warfare — he was known on earth as Citravarman and was a king.

sanskrit: haras tv ariharo vīra āsīd yo dānavottamaḥ suvāstur iti vikhyātaḥ sa jajñe manujarṣabhaḥ
english: He who was the heroic foremost of dānavas, Hara (or Arihara) — he was born as the bull among men known as Suvāstu.

sanskrit: aharas tu mahātejāḥ śatrupakṣakṣayaṃkaraḥ bāhlīko nāma rājā sa babhūva prathitaḥ kṣitau
english: Ahara, of great radiance, the destroyer of the enemy's side — he became the king renowned on earth as Bāhlīka.

sanskrit: nicandraś candravaktraś ca ya āsīd asurottamaḥ muñjakeśa iti khyātaḥ śrīmān āsīt sa pārthivaḥ
english: He who was the foremost asura known as Nicandra Candravaktra — the glorious Muñjakeśa was that king on earth.

sanskrit: nikumbhas tv ajitaḥ saṃkhye mahāmatir ajāyata bhūmau bhūmipatiḥ śreṣṭho devādhipa iti smṛtaḥ
english: Nikumbha, unvanquished in battle, of great intellect, was born on earth as the best of kings, remembered as Devādhipa.

sanskrit: śarabho nāma yas teṣāṃ daiteyānāṃ mahāsuraḥ pauravo nāma rājarṣiḥ sa babhūva nareṣv iha
english: He among those Daityas who was the great asura named Śarabha — he became the royal sage named Paurava here among men.

sanskrit: dvitīyaḥ śalabhas teṣām asurāṇāṃ babhūva yaḥ prahrādo nāma bāhlīkaḥ sa babhūva narādhipaḥ
english: He who was the second among those asuras, named Śalabha — he became the lord of men known as Bāhlīka Prahrāda.

sanskrit: candras tu ditijaśreṣṭho loke tārādhipopamaḥ ṛṣiko nāma rājarṣir babhūva nṛpasattamaḥ
english: Candra, the foremost of Diti's sons, comparable to the lord of stars, became the royal sage named Ṛṣika, the best of kings.

sanskrit: mṛtapā iti vikhyāto ya āsīd asurottamaḥ paścimānūpakaṃ viddhi taṃ nṛpaṃ nṛpasattama
english: He who was known as Mṛtapā, the foremost of asuras — know that king as the lord of the western marshlands, O best of kings.

sanskrit: gaviṣṭhas tu mahātejā yaḥ prakhyāto mahāsuraḥ drumasena iti khyātaḥ pṛthivyāṃ so 'bhavan nṛpaḥ
english: Gaviṣṭha, of great radiance, who was celebrated as a great asura — he became known on earth as Drumasena, a king.

sanskrit: mayūra iti vikhyātaḥ śrīmān yas tu mahāsuraḥ sa viśva iti vikhyāto babhūva pṛthivīpatiḥ
english: He who was the glorious great asura known as Mayūra — he became renowned as Viśva and was a lord of the earth.

sanskrit: suparṇa iti vikhyātas tasmād avarajas tu yaḥ kālakīrtir iti khyātaḥ pṛthivyāṃ so 'bhavan nṛpaḥ
english: He who was the younger brother of that one, known as Suparṇa — he became known on earth as Kālakīrti, a king.

sanskrit: candrahanteti yas teṣāṃ kīrtitaḥ pravaro 'suraḥ śunako nāma rājarṣiḥ sa babhūva narādhipaḥ
english: He among them who was celebrated as the pre-eminent asura Candrahanta — he became the royal sage named Śunaka, a lord of men.

sanskrit: vināśanas tu candrasya ya ākhyāto mahāsuraḥ jānakir nāma rājarṣiḥ sa babhūva narādhipaḥ
english: He who was named the great asura Vināśana of the moon — he became the royal sage named Jānakī, a lord of men.

sanskrit: dīrghajihvas tu kauravya ya ukto dānavarṣabhaḥ kāśirāja iti khyātaḥ pṛthivyāṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ
english: He who was called Dīrghajihva, the bull among dānavas, O descendant of the Kurus — he became known on earth as the Kāśirāja, lord of the earth.
